correction: Do not answer historical terminal queries into a live shell. MyGo queues replies asynchronously, so render replay with a write-discarding emulator and forward only its snapshot.
Discarding async completions at sign-out also requires clearing composer and transcript in-flight state and restoring unacknowledged send text to the original draft.
A manual stream retry must preserve the initial Connecting state so hello restores the saved session; clear the old reason while keeping the authenticated client.

The artifact web view's pocket_auth cookie must have the path /a/: OnWillNavigate does not see reloads or history moves, and Chromium lets a sandboxed page rewrite its URL path with history.replaceState, so only the cookie's path keeps the rest of the server signed out there

correction: Generic thread controls must not offer an unqualified Drop on plan threads: that route drops the entire plan. Match action availability to the Desk groups.
When the server falls back from a retired supervisor, follow the returned supervisor and clear editors from the previous board; otherwise the selector and every operation become stuck.
Metric records include closed threads outside the live Desk seven-day window. Fetch their detail when opening a record, including PR thread links, and show it in the inspector.
Search literal displayed argument values and tool result text, not JSON-escaped strings or wire metadata keys.
Default new schedules to the device IANA timezone when known; omit an empty zone so the server applies its own default, never silently assume UTC.
Use a transfer-sized timeout for uploads and cancel the transfer when its chip is removed or the sign-in ends; the generic 30-second request limit rejects supported files on slow uplinks.
Before merging an app change, merge its dependency PR and replace any testing pseudo-version with a release or commit reachable from the dependency default branch.
Reopening a pending creation must reuse its draft and replay key; closing a dialog must not lose the result or permit a duplicate creation.
Show a failed lessons read on an agent's page whenever the error is set, even when lessons read before it stay cached; a cached list under the error must not hide the error.
Number the reads of a wiki page and let only the newest answer change the pane, so a stale failure cannot hide a page that a newer read showed.
Clear the failed SVG state on the person's explicit artifact refresh only; events and the timer keep it, so a redraw never retries an SVG that failed.
